spec.headline: 3 MASS EFFECT GAMES FOR |$8.99|
spec.topic: Mass Effect Legendary Edition (ME1-3 remastered) on Steam US (appid 1328670): $59.99 list, $8.99 now (85% off, appdetails cc=us, checked 28 Nov 2026). Main stories about 68 h combined (SVG, from Attack of the Fanboy figures; HLTB per game ME1 17 h, ME2 ~24.5 h, ME3 ~24 h = ~66 h; a HLTB mirror lists 86 h for the LE entry, which would make it 10¢/h). 8.99/68 = 13¢/h. Full price 59.99/68 = 88¢/h. vs ~$12 movie for 2 h = $6/h. Test slot: versus/wallet hook (price vs movie ticket), not tagged cost per hour.
spec.credit: GAMEPLAY: BIOWARE / ELECTRONIC ARTS · DATA: STEAM, HOWLONGTOBEAT, SVG
